profile.headline: Software Engineer at Applied Research Laboratories, UT Austin
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer at Applied Research Laboratories at The University of Texas at Austin.

With prior experience as a software engineer at Microsoft and Lockheed Martin, a Master’s in Software Engineering from UT Austin, and a Bachelor’s in Computer Engineering from Texas A&M, I specialize in backend development and automation to support delivering scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient solutions. I'm passionate about delivering exceptional value to customers - not just meeting expectations, but exceeding them through thoughtful design, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement. 

Previously at Microsoft, I owned backend automation for monitoring and alerting in Azure billing systems, built CI/CD pipelines, queried and optimized both relational and non-relational databases, and generated configuration templates for both infrastructure and service deployment, enabling robust testing environments and streamlining operations to maintain data integrity.

At Lockheed Martin, I developed safety-critical OS software in embedded systems and led teams in adopting agile, DevSecOps, and CI/CD practices to improve efficiency and collaboration. I also updated infrastructure to support these initiatives by migrating to Git and restructuring assets to better align with modern workflows.

My graduate work at UT Austin included hands-on projects in full-stack development, machine learning, computer networks, containerization, parallel algorithms, and systems programming, deepening my expertise across modern software domains.

I bring a flexible, growth-oriented mindset shaped by diverse experiences across industries and technologies. My broad skill set allows me to contribute across domains, continuously improve systems and processes, and adapt quickly to new challenges. I thrive in environments that prioritize quality, clarity, and collaboration, and I approach every challenge with a detail-oriented, analytical mindset and a strong focus on building reliable, impactful solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Built and maintained systems that validate, normalize, and store Azure billing event data to ensure accurate pricing and enable API-based access using customer metadata, with regional failover for fault tolerance

•	Led automation workflows for service health monitoring and incident mitigation, improving time to resolution by 81%

•	Implemented encoding and mapping to reduce document size by >20%, cutting Cosmos DB storage costs by 20-40%

•	Enabled shared resource access across reliability groups using optimistic concurrency control to prevent conflicts & deadlocks 

•	Built pre-production testing environment, enabling early performance optimization and reducing production incidents 
     - Automated EV2 ARM template (JSON) generation, created CI/CD YAML pipelines
     - Coordinated onboarding of 7 partner teams, facilitating cross-team collaboration and technical alignment

•	Redesigned critical copy job to self-recover from stuck states, reducing manual intervention and data loss

•	Resolved bug causing empty event IDs, preventing loss of 1k+ events per month and billing errors for customers

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed, developed, integrated, and unit-tested safety-critical Operating System software on embedded systems
- Only team member that was fully cross-functional

•	Led team in developing a CI/CD pipeline for DevSecOps initiative, reducing deploy time by 87% & training 50+ engineers on Git & Jira

•	Built Python tool to generate optimized memory maps, maximizing memory efficiency and reducing fragmentation

•	Designed system-wide history log - Increased distinct entries by >300%, enhancing traceability and diagnostics

•	Served the role of Scrum Master for 2 teams of 11 engineers each, increasing average sprint velocity by 15.87 points
- Facilitated PI planning, sprint plannings, daily scrums, and reviews & retrospectives
- Presented weekly status to stakeholders and upper management
- Guided the teams to adopt agile principles and steer away from waterfall

•	Automated HTML-to-Excel metrics reporting via Python script, reducing weekly prep time by 99.9%

•	Improved a tool in Microsoft Access used for documenting defect findings and corrections during evaluation of products

•	Mentored interns to meaningful productivity within 2 weeks, demonstrating strong communication and leadership

•	Presented an in-depth update on the development of a working prototype to stakeholders

positions.title: Xeon Platform Application Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
•	Worked onsite from May 28, 2018 to August 18, 2018. Worked remotely while at school from August 18, 2018 to December 12, 2018

•	Implemented internal full-stack web application travel tool
- Event calendar for employees to coordinate travel plans that will allow team to save 50-75% on rental cars and streamline customer presentations
- Closed out 46 stories over 12 weeks

•	Debugged client build issues on a Microsoft Surface Pro
- Delivered system to a Senior Manager
- Resolved a three-year IT problem in just 3 weeks

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: Designing a personal portfolio website to showcase projects, experience, and skills, with plans to implement a React front end, modular backend microservices in Node.js, C# (ASP.NET Core + .NET 8), and Python, deployed via Docker, Kubernetes, and Google Cloud Run, and integrated with GitHub Actions for automated CI/CD. Using Claude Code to assist development.

projects.title: Calculator in Java Swing Using Shunting Yard Algorithm
projects.description: Built a Java Swing calculator using the Shunting Yard Algorithm to convert infix to postfix notation. Designed an intuitive GUI and implemented smart input validation (e.g., auto-inserting multiplication symbols, balancing parentheses, and correcting decimal inputs) to prevent invalid expressions.
